system: Act as a concise read-only software/runtime reviewer. Inspect only Little World Lab, its Falcon live workflow, and generic llama.cpp/OpenAI compatibility assumptions as needed. Do not edit anything. Do not propose modifications to, imports from, or runtime coupling with The Room or Emily/Olivia workflows/state.
prompt: We are finishing isolated Little World Lab real-Falcon smoke. Current model bartowski/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M loads successfully in current ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server. Plain unconstrained calls previously generated 120 tokens every time and living_world.py failed strict json.loads because output was not exactly one JSON object. We then tried server-global --json-schema-file. Both schema versions fail every request before generation with HTTP 400 Failed to initialize samplers: std::exception. After removing all maxLength constraints, server logs still show common_sampler_init failing on the generated JSON grammar, including the generic JSON string character rule, char-star string rule, optional fields, and enum action type. Model load also warns that the model vocabulary is missing a newline token and uses the special pad id instead. /v1/models reports vocab 131072, 1.669B params, Q4_K_M. We need backend_errors=0 for 4 real actions while keeping engine validation authoritative. Determine the most robust next move. Specifically assess: (1) abandon grammar for this Falcon/tokenizer and use prompt + max_tokens 256 + bounded first-balanced-JSON-object extractor; (2) use response_format json_object, which may hit the same grammar sampler; (3) hand-written much simpler grammar; or (4) another minimal llama.cpp option. Give an exact recommendation based on repo/current behavior, with concrete living_world.py changes and tests if parser fallback is best. The parser must never repair truncated JSON and must only return one fully balanced top-level object; engine validation remains sole state authority. Also suggest prompt changes that make a 1B Falcon emit JSON early rather than reasoning until max_tokens. Finish with a tiny isolated patch plan. No Room or Emily/Olivia changes.
expected_response: Exact robust fallback after Falcon grammar-sampler failure, with parser/prompt/request changes and tests limited to Little World Lab.
